subject: *: generalize some vector index logic to columnar index (#59881)
summary: Reviewed 9fed88cc vs first parent, scoped to executor/planner/statistics. Changes are a mechanical generalization: replace direct `VectorInfo != nil` checks with `IndexInfo.IsTiFlashLocalIndex()` (TiFlash-local/columnar index marker at this commit) in CHECK TABLE/CLEANUP INDEX gating, access-path generation, ANALYZE index skipping, and auto-analyze missing-index checks, plus corresponding warning/error wording updates from “vector” to “columnar”. No correctness/semantic regression found in these modules; later history up to `upstream/master` shows follow-up refactors (e.g. renaming to `IsColumnarIndex`) but no evidence of a bug fix needed for this commit.
